name: Beta 1.0.25
notes: Real orbits: inner planets now circle the sun faster than outer ones, so each planet drifts towards and away from the station and trip times rise and fall with the distance; colony stockpiles become silos (new Ore Silos and Deep Silos research) that store ore through the far stretch; the Planet tab shows a chart of a whole cycle, a silo gauge and the next close pass
